title: NCSM Notification 2026 - Apply Offline for Technician Posts
description: The National Council of Science Museums (NCSM) has officially released the notification to fill the vacancy for 01 Technician Post. Interested and eligible candidates can use this opportunity to apply for this post before the deadline. Candidates who have completed their 10th and ITI can apply for the NCSM Notification 2026 . Interested applicants can apply offline. Here we have mentioned the education details, age limit, selection process, application fee, salary, and how to apply for these ...
